================================================================================
BUILD AND INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: libxlsxwriter on Windows / MinGW
================================================================================

1. PREREQUISITES:
libxlsxwriter requires zlib. In standard MinGW-w64 environments:
- If using MSYS2 / MinGW64 terminal:
    pacman -S mingw-w64-x86_64-libxlsxwriter mingw-w64-x86_64-zlib
- If installing manually from source on Windows:
    git clone https://github.com/jmcnamara/libxlsxwriter.git
    cd libxlsxwriter
    cmake -B build -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=C:/libxlsxwriter -DBUILD_STATIC=ON
    cmake --build build --config Release
    cmake --install build

Assuming libxlsxwriter is installed at C:/libxlsxwriter (or MSYS2 standard paths),
headers will be at:
    C:/libxlsxwriter/include
and static library at:
    C:/libxlsxwriter/lib/libxlsxwriter.a

2. UPDATED G++ COMPILATION COMMANDS:

If libxlsxwriter is installed in C:/libxlsxwriter (or via MSYS2 where include/lib are in compiler paths):

A. train.exe:
g++ -std=c++17 -O3 -fopenmp train.cpp -o train.exe -I C:/libxlsxwriter/include -L C:/libxlsxwriter/lib -lxlsxwriter -lz -lws2_32 -lpthread

B. visualizer.exe:
g++ -std=c++17 -O3 visualizer.cpp -o visualizer.exe -I C:/raylib/raylib/src -I C:/libxlsxwriter/include -L C:/raylib/raylib/src -L C:/libxlsxwriter/lib -lraylib -lxlsxwriter -lz -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm -lpthread

C. benchmark.exe:
g++ -std=c++17 -O3 benchmark.cpp -o benchmark.exe -I C:/libxlsxwriter/include -L C:/libxlsxwriter/lib -lxlsxwriter -lz -lpthread

D. export_weights.exe (No xlsxwriter dependency needed):
g++ -std=c++17 -O3 export_weights.cpp -o export_weights.exe

3. MAKEFILE OVERRIDES:
When using `mingw32-make all`, pass the include and lib directory overrides:
mingw32-make all XLSX_INC="-I C:/libxlsxwriter/include" XLSX_LIB="-L C:/libxlsxwriter/lib -lxlsxwriter -lz"
================================================================================
